deviations_from_spec: NONE in design/layout/algorithm. One SELF-INFLICTED authoring fix (not a spec deviation): the q5km_matmul_rb_coopmat_f32acc_cached.axc header comment originally mentioned the literal substring '@strategy' inside a prose comment BEFORE the real @strategy annotation; the driver's strip_strategy_annotation_block does a naive source.find("@strategy") for the FIRST occurrence and bailed on the comment instead of the real annotation, leaving all 5 holes unresolved at codegen. Fixed by rewording the comment to avoid the literal substring before the real annotation — a documentation-only change, not a compiler change (this quirk pre-exists in axc-driver::strip_strategy_annotation_block and was not touched).

self_assessment.spec_coverage: All M3.14 r2 spec deliverables implemented: Q6_K oracle+kernel (M3.14a), Q5_K_M oracle+kernel+coopmat-leader-extension (M3.14b), AT-2811..2823 all implemented and passing (CPU + CI compile-anchor + real-GPU Lavapipe/NVIDIA paths verified where hardware-gated tests could be run locally).
known_limitations: Golden fixtures for AT-2811/AT-2816 use the hand-computed-from-formula fallback (no live ggml byte dump cross-check was available in this environment) — explicitly permitted by spec §6 as an annotated fallback; QA should note this and a future milestone could add a real ggml dump cross-check as a drop-in.

AT-2814/AT-2815/AT-2819/AT-2820/AT-2822/AT-2823 were run and verified passing on real NVIDIA hardware in this environment; Lavapipe CI execution of the NOT-#[ignore] tests (AT-2814, AT-2819) was not separately re-verified here (only the driver-level spirv-val + capability-set anchors were checked without Lavapipe) since this box's default Vulkan ICD routed to the real NVIDIA GPU — the kernels are pure f32 buffer I/O with no coopmat/f16-storage requirement so Lavapipe compatibility follows the same pattern as the already-Lavapipe-proven q4km_dequant_matmul.axc (AT-1520 class).
